name: Pagination support for the Eventstream HTTP connector
description: The Eventstream HTTP connector now supports pagination, letting you ingest data from REST APIs that return results across multiple pages. Many third-party services cap each response and require follow-up requests to retrieve the full data set; pagination handling lets Eventstream collect those pages automatically.With this capability, you can:- Ingest complete data sets from paginated REST endpoints without custom code.- Configure page navigation rules so the connector follows next-page links or tokens.- Stream API results continuously into Eventstream destinations for real-time analysis.
